### Phase 10: explicit Fast two-anchor preset

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase10-two-anchor-prediction/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Add an explicit Fast target-rate preset that uses two exact anchors to predict a default-entropy finalist directly, while preserving the exhaustive controller as the default Quality preset. Fast may trade a wider, documented undershoot band and measured perceptual quality for lower latency, but must verify the final stream exactly, never exceed the target, remain deterministic, and fall back to Quality when its bounded search cannot satisfy its contract.
